description: End-to-end order-to-cash workflow for provisioning, deploying, billing, and managing edge applications in a TaaS Edge environment.

edge_application_id.description: Unique identifier of an edge application instance

deployment_plan_id.description: Identifier for a saved deployment plan

deployment_id.description: Identifier for a specific deployment execution

customer_id.description: Unique tenant or customer account identifier

order_id.description: Order identifier for provisioning and billing

rollback_request_id.description: Identifier for a rollback or cancel request

region.description: Geographic or logical region identifier (e.g., us-east-1-edge, eu-central-lowlatency)

edge_node_id.description: Identifier of a specific edge node within a region

runtime_profile.description: Reusable runtime configuration profile for edge applications

version.description: Runtime or language version (e.g., nodejs-18, python-3.11)

functions.name: list_edge_offers
functions.description: List available edge application product offers and deployment SKUs for a customer.

region_filters.description: Optional list of regions to filter offers by availability location.

max_latency_ms.description: Maximum target end-to-end latency in milliseconds.

storage_required_gb.description: Minimum persistent storage per node in GB.

functions.returns: Paginated list of edge product offers and SKUs with pricing summaries and technical capabilities.

functions.name: design_edge_deployment_plan
functions.description: Create or update a deployment plan defining topology, capacity, and SLAs for an edge application.

deployment_plan_id.description: Existing plan ID to update; if omitted, a new plan is created.

edge_offer_sku.description: Selected offer or SKU ID from list_edge_offers.

application_profile.description: Logical description of the application being deployed.

topology.description: Topology configuration for edge regions and nodes.

regions.description: Regions where the application will be deployed.

sla_requirements.description: SLA expectations used for pricing and feasibility checks.

commit_changes.description: If false, runs validation and pricing simulation only.

functions.returns: Created or updated deployment plan with feasibility validation, estimated pricing, and plan identifier.

functions.name: create_edge_order
functions.description: Create an order for an edge application based on a deployment plan, including contract and billing terms.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, SGD.

payment_token.description: Opaque token for stored payment method (if applicable).

order_metadata.description: Optional metadata and tags associated with the order.

simulate_only.description: If true, returns quote without creating an actual order.

functions.returns: Order quote or created order with order_id, commercial details, and activation pre-checks.

functions.name: activate_edge_order
functions.description: Activate a previously created edge order and create an edge application record.

accept_terms.description: Confirms acceptance of service and SLA terms.

start_date.description: Planned activation start time; if omitted, activation is immediate.

staged_activation.description: If true, activates only in test or subset regions initially.

initial_regions.description: If staged_activation, list of regions to activate first.

functions.returns: Edge application record with edge_application_id, activation schedule, and initial status.

functions.name: provision_edge_resources
functions.description: Provision and allocate edge compute, storage, and network resources for an edge application.

regions.description: Regions to target when scope is selected_regions or single_region.

security_policies.description: Security controls applied at the edge.

functions.returns: Provisioning task with deployment_id, per-region resource allocation status, and any pending actions.

functions.name: deploy_edge_application_version
functions.description: Deploy a specific application version or artifact to provisioned edge resources.

deployment_id.description: Existing deployment execution to update; if omitted, a new deployment execution is created.

artifact.description: Reference to application artifact or image.

rollout_strategy.description: Rollout strategy for deploying the new version.

regions.description: Optional subset of regions for staged rollout.

runtime_overrides.description: Optional overrides to runtime profile at deployment time.

functions.returns: Deployment execution information including deployment_id, per-region rollout plan, and initial status.

functions.name: get_edge_deployment_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status and health for an edge deployment, with per-region and per-node details.

include.description: Additional data to include in the response.

functions.returns: Deployment status summary including global state, per-region and per-node rollout, any errors, and key health indicators.

functions.name: modify_edge_application
functions.description: Modify configuration, capacity, or topology of an existing edge application.

dry_run.description: If true, returns impact analysis without applying changes.

functions.returns: Updated edge application configuration or impact analysis, with any required re-deployment actions.

functions.name: generate_edge_usage_invoice
functions.description: Generate or retrieve an invoice for edge application usage and committed charges.

regenerate.description: If true, forces recalculation even if an invoice already exists for the period.

functions.returns: Invoice summary with invoice_id, line items, taxes, discounts, and cost breakdown by selected dimensions.

functions.name: get_invoice_status
functions.description: Retrieve status, payment details, and aging information for a specific invoice.
functions.returns: Invoice details including status, due amount, payment history, and any disputes or adjustments.

functions.name: retry_edge_operation
functions.description: Retry a failed or partial operation such as provisioning, deployment, or billing for an edge application.

target_id.description: Associated identifier: deployment_id, order_id, or invoice_id depending on operation_type.

override_params.description: Optional parameters to adjust for the retry (e.g., different region, capacity).

functions.returns: Retry job status with new operation tracking identifier and initial state.

functions.name: rollback_edge_deployment
functions.description: Rollback an edge deployment to a previous stable version in case of failures or SLA violations.

rollback_request_id.description: Client-provided id for idempotency and tracking.

regions.description: If region_scoped or partial rollback, list of regions to rollback.

reason_details.description: Free-form description of the rollback reason.

functions.returns: Rollback execution details with rollback_request_id, targeted previous version, and status per region.

functions.name: cancel_edge_order_and_decommission
functions.description: Cancel an edge order and decommission associated edge application resources, with options for data retention.

effective_date.description: When cancellation should take effect; if in the future, schedules a termination.

force.description: If true, forces immediate decommissioning even if there are ongoing deployments.

functions.returns: Cancellation and decommissioning plan with rollback_request_id, timeline, final billing summary, and data retention schedule.

functions.name: search_edge_deployments
functions.description: Faceted search across edge application deployments with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of edge application deployment summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_edge_deployments
functions.description: Create multiple edge application deployments in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created edge application deployment ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_edge_deployments
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many edge application deployments with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each edge application deployment, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_edge_deployments
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many edge application deployments in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each edge application deployment, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_edge_deployments
functions.description: Export edge application deployment datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_edge_deployments
functions.description: Bulk-import edge application deployment records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated edge application deployments.

functions.name: subscribe_to_edge_deployment_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive edge application deployment lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the edge application deployment.

functions.name: get_edge_deployment_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a edge application deployment, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the edge application deployment, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_edge_deployment_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for edge application deployments using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the edge application deployment action.

functions.name: simulate_edge_deployment_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a edge application deployment without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the edge application deployment, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_edge_deployment_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a edge application deployment change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the edge application deployment under change.

functions.name: decide_edge_deployment_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending edge application deployment approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the edge application deployment.

functions.name: add_edge_deployment_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a edge application deployment for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the edge application deployment.

functions.name: upload_edge_deployment_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a edge application deployment with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the edge application deployment.

functions.name: create_edge_deployment_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a edge application deployment (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the edge application deployment version captured.

functions.name: restore_edge_deployment_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a edge application deployment from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the edge application deployment.

functions.name: get_edge_deployment_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for edge application deployments over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the edge application deployment domain context.

functions.name: get_edge_deployment_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for edge application deployments combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the edge application deployment context.

functions.name: create_edge_deployment_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to edge application deployments with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current edge application deployments.

functions.name: evaluate_edge_deployment_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a edge application deployment in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the edge application deployment.

functions.name: get_edge_deployment_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a edge application deployment including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the edge application deployment, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_edge_deployment_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a edge application deployment and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the edge application deployment.

functions.name: assign_edge_deployment_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a edge application deployment with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the edge application deployment with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_edge_deployments
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more edge application deployments, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each edge application deployment.

functions.name: compare_edge_deployment_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a edge application deployment with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the edge application deployment, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_edge_deployment_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to edge application deployment operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of edge application deployment operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_edge_deployment_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a edge application deployment and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the edge application deployment, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_edge_deployment
functions.description: Clone a edge application deployment into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned edge application deployment record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_edge_deployment_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted edge application deployment report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the edge application deployment window covered.

functions.name: escalate_edge_deployment
functions.description: Escalate a edge application deployment to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the edge application deployment.
